help: run the tests, then every pipeline over data/input/, the one named, or one input item of it - processing only, never acquiring

args.name: pipeline
args.help: one pipeline by name (bare: all of them); validated against the pipelines that exist

args.name: item
args.help: one input item under that pipeline's root (bare: the whole root); passed to the pipeline's run.sh as --item

args.name: --plan
args.help: print the ordered step plan; run nothing

args.name: --stage
args.help: read shared storage with this room's stage laid over it (tmp/input), so that what is captured and not yet promoted is run before the merge that licenses its promotion

pip install --upgrade pip: reaches PyPI on every run to check for an upgrade; skipped with a note under YOGA_NO_SEND
pip install -r src/requirements.txt: reaches PyPI when the venv lacks packages; skipped under YOGA_NO_SEND, so a fresh venv then fails at first import, visibly
